title: Not worth the value...lackluster
text: I gave 3 stars because I was excited about the deadpool theme and since the subscription moved to Amazon I decided to renew. I have been a founder since the subscription first started and I have got to say, that lately I feel like the boxes are not worth the value. For example in the Deadpool box, the pop was really cool, but everything else seemed like a cop out. The taco holder was straight up cheap looking, and not very collectable or practical. The keychain was alright, but you can get funko keychains anywhere, same with the luggage tag. I also miss getting the T-Shirts. If you are going to make something "exclusive" I feel like it should be more unique. I am a big Venom fan, so I am going to purchase the next box, but if it is as lackluster as the last few MCC boxes, I think I will cancel my subscription.
label: neutral
